hints.title: Nested Key Path Flattening and Matrix Alignment
hints.text: Converting nested dictionaries into tabular format requires gathering all dot-delimited key paths, sorting column names, and generating rows with empty string fallbacks.

hints.title: Recursive Path Extraction and Lexicographic Ordering
hints.text: Recursively extract leaf paths for each object. Collect all distinct paths into a sorted array of column headers. Construct output rows by mapping each column key.

hints.title: Matrix Generation Blueprint
hints.text: For each item in arr, extract map of path -> primitive. Union all unique path keys and sort lexicographically. Build first row from keys. For each item map, append row where cell is map.get(k) ?? "".

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of objects in input array
K: total distinct leaf key paths
complexity.notes: Extracts leaf paths for each object and sorts unique column headers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Top-level Object.keys fails to traverse nested objects and arrays, missing deeply nested column headers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lexicographically sorted header set aligns sparse rows with constant lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct dot-separated path concatenation and handling of null as a primitive.

solutions.approach: Recursive Path Flattening with Lexicographical Column Alignment
